tasks.name: add_acc
tasks.working: The group's BUSY_COUNTER is reset by the accepted start and counts each busy cycle; busy rises the cycle after the start. L 0, II 1, inputs always valid and the output always ready: a firing every busy cycle from busy cycle 2, the 8th the run's last: 9 busy cycles. A sliced input takes its first word in busy cycle 1 and shows it the next, so the first firing is in busy cycle 2.
